Package com.pulumi.core.annotations

Annotation Interface CustomType

@Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(TYPE) public @interface CustomType
Annotation used by a Pulumi Cloud Provider Package to mark complex types used for a Resource output property.

A complex type must have a single builder marked with the CustomType.Builder annotation.
